verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair axis for a meeting-recording SaaS, but the evidence documents no retention settings and no way to delete recordings, transcripts or summaries. The only deletion evidence is the 'Delete a webhook' endpoint, which removes an integration rather than meeting data. The download and export endpoints are a different capability, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
